description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Nine)] and [Wind Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Nine)
description.text: Wind abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and critical chance =50/75%/100% for equipped Wind abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Wind abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Wind Mode II (Nine)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Wind Mode II (Nine)
description.text: Wind abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Wind abilities, grants [100% Critical (15s)] and [Dualcast Dragoon 1] to all allies after using Wind abilities, causes [Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)] after using Wind abilities if 4+ Type-0 allies are alive

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 30% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 30% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 30% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 30% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 30% (15s)], [Imperil Water 30% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 30% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 30% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 30% (15s)]

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3
